description: A SOURCE-COMPUTER, OBJECT-COMPUTER or SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph written as its header, its period and a second separator period with no entry between them (SOURCE-COMPUTER. .) - a COBOL-2002 spelling read from the printed formats. The 1985 formats (§1985:VI.4.3.2, §1985:VI.4.4.2, §1985:VI.4.5.2, printed pages VI-10, VI-11 and VI-13) print the second period INSIDE the bracket that holds the paragraph's entries, so it is written only with an entry, and §1985:IV.4.2.1 rule 3 allows a period only at a sentence's end "or as shown in formats"; the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 formats print it outside the bracket, with 12.2.4.2 SR1, 12.2.5.2 SR4 and 12.2.6.2 SR27 letting it be omitted when nothing is written (§2023:12.3.5.3 SR1, §2023:12.3.6.3 SR4, §2023:12.3.7.3 SR31). kb/Work PB5170. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.GateLonePeriod, from the three paragraphs' visits through the one reader ParagraphPeriods.LonePeriod (VCR row 7.52).
display: a configuration paragraph with a second separator period and no entry
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.52 (f) - the lone second period of a configuration paragraph, read from the printed formats
